tei:div.tei:p: 333) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dbang chen padma he ru ka'i drag sgrub pha rol dpung 'joms bzhugs: 334) na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye: (Dakini secret letter here)

padma he ru ka la 'dud: rim gnyis nyams su len pa'i bu: skal ldan lta dgongs dang ldan pas: yi dam padma dbang chen gyi: drag sgrub zab mor brtson pa'i thabs: dgra bgegs pha rol dpung 'joms bstan: sa ma ya: lag tu len pa'i rim pa la: dug shog ngos la dug khrag gis: dgra bgegs ru pa bri ba ni: mi gzugs nyam thag gcer bu yi: yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams shing: mig long kha lkugs rna bar 'on: dpral bar nan dang brla dpung chag chag bris: snying gar nṛ tri gsang bar phaṭaḥdang ni: mgo steng nas brtsams rbad bsad sngags kyis bskor: phyi ma dza khrom dag gis yongs su bskor: zag rdzas 335) byugs shing sngo dmar tshon skud kyis: ro ltebs tshul gyis bcings nas brub khung du: 'phangs nas 'gugs sgrol thun rdzas la sogs bsags: rang nyid dbang chen lha yi nga rgyal gyis: dang po e khang bskyed pa ni: skad cig gis mdun du e yig nag po yongs su gyur pa las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po zur gsum pa kha dog cing gting zab pa: phyi la zhe sdang gi me 'ur 'ur du 'bar ba: nang na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho rba rlabs g.yo ba: bar na gti mug gi mun nag 'thib cing phrag dog gi rlung nag 'tshubs pa: las kyi pho nyas mtha' 336)nas bskor zhing thun mtshon me dpung 'bar ba'i char bab cing 'jigs su rung zhing ya nga ba'i nang du nṛ dang tri yig yongs su gyur pa las dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs de nyid mdog sngo la ham pa: mig shi mig: kha ngu ba: lag pa mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can rkang lag lcags sgrog tu bcug pa: lus kyi bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing gcer bu nyams thag pa: mgon skyabs med cing mdangs nyams pa: dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar hri li li byed pa gcig tu gyur: kho'i snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas snang srid khams kyi dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams kyi bla tshe srog gsum mthu nus dang bcas pa thams cad 'od nag gi rnam par 'ub kyis 'dus te ling ga la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur:

bdag mdun gyi sku las sprul pa'i pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas ling ga la thim par gyur: de nas 'gugs pa ni: na mo: rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa 337) dang: sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos sku longs sku sprul sku rnams kyi bka'= yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka'= chos nyid gdod nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa'i lag dmar: sgos rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra: bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: rnal 'byor yongs kyi sgos dgra: dam sri ya ma spun dgu: rgyal bstan spyi la gnod pa'i rgya 'dre me zhon: 'byung po rlung zhon: rgyal btsan the'u rang bdud 'gong dam sri la sogs pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshe bla srog gsum mthu nus thams cad stong gsum ri rab gling bzhi gang na gnas kyang skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs rū pa 'di la khug cig: nṛ a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ trei a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig brjod mthar: oṃ badzra kro dha hya grī wa badzra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa a ya 338) ma du ru tsa sha na gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ khug dzaḥ nṛ tri yaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes 'gugs rtags ma byung bar du brtsonaḥ de las lha dbye ni: hūm̐ bhyo: dpal chen che mchog padma he ru ka'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: ma g.yel dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: sdang bar byed pa'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs kyi:

srung skyob lha srung kun dang da phyes shig: mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud dang myur du sprod: rtsa sngags mthar: ma ma traka rakṣa mā ra ya phyes phyes khrol khrol ru tra mā ra ya rbad: de nas gzugs la dbab pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo: dpal gyi che mchog padma he ru ka'i: sku las sprul pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'phros: nyams pa bdun ldan dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs: lcags kyus zungs la zhags pa 'bar bas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdom par gyis: dril bus smyor chugs brgyal nas rengs su chugs: bla srog rnam shes gzugs byang rten la bstims: dril sngags mthar: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badzra spho 339)ṭa bam̐: oṃ badzra gaṇḍe ho: ru tra sha truṃ mā ra ya thib thib myos myos chings chings rbad sod: de nas bcing ba'i las ni: hūm̐ bhyo: dbang chen lha tshogs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: ma g.yel dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: nyams pa bdun ldan dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi: sgo gsum mthu nus stobs rtsal ma lus kun: khrol med phrin las phyag rgyas dam du chings: nam yang ldang med byad du bcug par mdzod: dril sngags mthar: ru tra a mu ka mā ra ya chings chings badzra pa sha hūm̐: de nas thun gdab pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo: dpal chen padma dbang gi dkyil 'khor lha: ma g.yel dam tshig thugs dam dus la babs: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul pa yi: las byed pho nya'i tshogs kyi dus la babs: dug thun mtshon cha'i zor kha dgra la phebs: gnyis snang bdag lta'i 'khrul pa rdul du rlog: phur thun zor kha dgra dang bgegs la phobs: ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags rdul du rlog: sa thun drag po'i zor kha dgra la phobs: nga rgyal 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor rdul du rlog: chu thun drag po'i zor kha 340)dgra la phobs: zhe sdang 'khor ba'i bag chags rdul du rlog: me thun drag po'i zor kha dgra la phobs: nyon mongs 'dod chags 'khrul snang rdul du rlog:

rlung thun zor kha dgra dang bgegs la phobs: phrag dog 'khrul pa'i bag chags rdul du rlog: sna tshogs thun gyi zor kha dgra la phebs: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags rdul du rlog: dril sngags mthar: dgra gdon bgegs tshogs rnams kyi bla tshe srog gi steng du thun bhyo rbad sod phob dza phob dza ma ra ya phaṭa: de nas gtun du rdung pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: ma g.yel thugs dam dus la babs: nyams pa bdun ldan dgra bgegs 'di: rdo rje 'bar bas gtun du brdung: rdul phran phye mar brlag par gyis: 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i 'ching rgya khrol: dril sngags mthar: dgra bgegs sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: ta tha ya ta tha ya rbad sod: de nang bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: nyams pa bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dbang yul phung khams bcas pa kun: mnyam nyid bde chen zhal 341)du bstabs: 'gags med rol pa'i mgrin par brgyud: chos dbyings yangs pa'i lto bar brubs: 'khrul med ka dag chen por drongs: rtsa sngags mthar: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rakta la khā hi: ma hā tsitta la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: la hā bsu ta la khā hi: zhes bstabs nas srid pa las kyi 'khrul pa thams cad dbyings su rol par bsam mo: sa ma ya: e maḥphyi rabs skal ldan las 'phro ldan rnams kyis: bskyed rim gnad zab nyams len lhur blang nas: sgrub pa'i ltas byung 'grub rtags mngon gyur tshe: drag po'i las kyi sbyor ba 'dir brtson na: dgra bgegs thul zhing phyi nang bar chad zhi: zab gyur gdams pa gcig chog 'di kho na: pad 'byung bdag gis mtsho rgyal khyed la gdams: ma 'ongs don du mi 'gyur brda ru thob: snyigs ma nyi shu kha ral dus kyi tshe: ḍā ki'i sprul par 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab: skal ldan las can rnams kyi dpal du shar: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis thub par srungs:

sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: sbas rgya: gter rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang 342) chos kyi bdag po ga ga hri da'i sgyu 'phrul mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang rang gi nye gnas shākya'i dge btsun gu ru padma'i lung zin yi ge'i 'du byed tshul khrims rdo rje/ bu mo chos dbyings sgron ma sogs kyis nan cher yang yang bskul ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes rang lo zhe gcig bskal pa chu sprel lo'i yar tshes la nyams chos yig ris su bris pa 'dis kyang rgya 'dre'i dmag 'khrugs kyi g.yul ngo rdul du brlags nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen dar zhing rgyas ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ dge'o//
